sources.field_scope: Guide and outfitter explainer. Certificate required for compensation over $100 on public land. Guide year April 1 through March 31. Orientation course and a hunting, fishing, or combination license required. Dollar fees printed for outfitter, guide, and spotter, resident and nonresident. No public name list. Affiliated-guide lists go to the outfitter by email. Contact lines were not copied.
sources.attribution: Footer copyright 2026 State of Utah. Terms allow unmodified personal or informational use.
sources.request_process: Apply on the application page. An outfitter emails the division for that outfitter's own guide list. No public-records request was submitted.

sources.field_scope: Rule R657-72. Guide year, application contents, federal permits for federal land, insurance attestation without a dollar minimum, annual renewal, and field limits. The page prints an authorizing citation of 12A-4-1204. Notice of continuation: new rule.
Section 23A-4-1201, effective 2026-05-06. Compensation over $100. Hunting includes fishing. Guide and outfitter definitions. The extract does not define a spotter.

Section 23A-4-1202, effective 2026-05-06. Annual certificate. The division maintains a record of each registered person. Fees are set under section 63J-1-504. The PDF extract does not print dollar amounts.
sources.bulk: Statute. The required record was not found as a public file.
sources.request_process: Already posted. No records request was submitted.

sources.field_scope: Section 23A-4-1204, effective 2026-05-06. Limits who may be compensated to guide or outfit on public land. Cap of two registered people, or three on a once-in-a-lifetime or limited-entry big-game hunt.

2026 big-game field regulations. Says guides and outfitters are regulated by the division and that the 2026 legislature removed several spotter requirements. Not a fishing roster. Office addresses and telephones were not copied.
sources.bulk: One guidebook. Not a guide roster.
sources.attribution: No separate reuse sentence in the extract.

sources.field_scope: Fishing guidebook labeled 2026. Tailwater from the Colorado line upstream to Flaming Gorge Dam: trout limit 3 with a 15-to-22-inch release slot, artificial flies and lures only, closed to fishing from a motorboat. Points guides to the division guides page. Not a roster.
sources.bulk: One booklet. Not a guide roster.
sources.attribution: No reuse sentence in the extracts read.

sources.field_scope: Utah and Wyoming angler rules for Flaming Gorge Reservoir, tables as of 2024-10-01. Reciprocal fishing permits. Not a guide roster. A telephone on the page was not copied.
